# Repository instructions

Read and follow `/AGENTS.md` before changing this repository. It is the
canonical project guide. Also follow the nearest nested `AGENTS.md` when
working under `parser/`, `plugins/`, or `docs/`.

Use `/BLACKSTORK_TEMPLATE_AUTHORING.md` for BlackStork template syntax. Do not
invent blocks, runners, arguments, or environment variables; verify them in
the implementation and generated plugin reference.
